name: White Zinc Plating
description: Basic sacrificial coating. Early white rust. Not recommended for outdoor use.

name: Yellow Zinc Plating / Dichromate
description: Yellow/iridescent passivation significantly increases corrosion protection compared to white zinc.

name: Hot-Dip Galvanizing (Z-100)
description: 100 g/m² zinc coating weight (sum of faces). Light layer, focused on indoor or low-aggression environments.

name: Hot-Dip Galvanizing (Z-180)
description: 180 g/m² zinc coating weight. Intermediate protection, very common in roofing and light structural profiles.

name: Hot-Dip Galvanizing (Z-275)
description: 275 g/m² zinc coating weight. Robust standard for outdoor environments subject to weathering.

name: Zinc Phosphating
description: Creates a layer of zinc crystals. Excellent adhesion base for paints or oil retention.

name: Manganese Phosphating
description: Mechanical focus: creates a porous layer ideal for retaining protective oil and reducing friction in moving parts.

name: Sulfuric Anodizing
description: Exclusive to Aluminum. Transforms the surface into aluminum oxide (hard and inert), allowing for dyeing.

name: Hard Chrome
description: Focused on extreme hardness and wear resistance (e.g., hydraulic cylinder rods).

name: Polyurethane (PU) Painting
description: Premium aesthetic finish, with excellent UV resistance (does not chalk/fade in the sun).

name: Epoxy Powder Coating
description: High chemical and mechanical impact resistance, but suffers chalking if exposed directly to the sun.

name: KTL (E-Coat / Cataphoresis) Painting
description: Electrical immersion painting. Excellent penetration in tubes and hidden parts. Automotive standard.

name: Geomet / Flake
description: Zinc/aluminum flakes. Does not cause hydrogen embrittlement. Gold standard for structural fasteners.
